description: Upload a receipt file (png, jpg, jpeg, pdf; up to 25 MB) to SAP Concur. Pass exactly one of: `path` — a file on this computer, inside the allowed upload folders (CONCUR_UPLOAD_ROOTS when set, otherwise the working directory, ~/Downloads, ~/Documents or ~/Desktop) — local installs only; `inline` — the bytes as base64, for a small file; or `blobKey` — a file PUT to an upload URL from concur_upload_slots (the way to send a file to a hosted server). Its contents must match its type; anything else is refused before a byte is sent. With `reportId` + `expenseId` it is attached to that expense straight away (`append: true` adds it to a receipt the expense already has); otherwise it lands in your available receipts. The preview names the file, its size and SHA-256, and the target expense; an upload-slot file is deleted from the slot once Concur has it. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

append.description: When the expense already has a receipt, add this image to it instead of refusing.

blobKey.description: The blobKey of an upload slot from concur_upload_slots, after the file was PUT to its URL.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

expenseId.description: Expense to attach the receipt to (needs `reportId`).

inline.description: The file itself: {filename, contentBase64, mimeType?}. Best for small files.

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, standard base64 (line breaks and a "data:<type>;base64," prefix are tolerated).

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot. Its extension sets the MIME type when mimeType is omitted.

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "image/jpeg". Default: inferred from the filename extension.

path.description: Local file path (a leading ~ is expanded; relative paths resolve against the working directory). Local installs only.

reportId.description: Report holding `expenseId` — attach the receipt to that expense.

name: concur_upload_receipt
